posts.title: Brazilian cleaning checklist for Greer homes
posts.text:
Brazilian house cleaning in Greer SC means the team works with a checklist in hand and does not skip the small stuff. Here is what we run through in a typical home near Downtown Greer, along SC-14 or close to GSP Airport.

A short checklist you can use to judge any clean:
- Baseboards and door frames wiped by hand, not just dusted
- Furniture and small items moved, with the floor cleaned underneath
- Switches, handles and cabinet fronts detailed
- Bathrooms scrubbed down to the grout and the base of the toilet
- Kitchen degreased: stovetop, hood and cabinet fronts
- Floors hand-washed along the walls and in the corners

We finish every visit with a walk-through against the room checklist, so nothing depends on memory. Families in Greenville and Spartanburg counties often tell us the corners are what they notice first. Tap Learn more to see what the Brazilian method includes in Greer.

posts.title: Pre-holiday deep cleaning in Easley, SC
posts.text:
Deep cleaning Easley SC makes the most sense right now, before the holidays fill the calendar. Fall and early winter keep windows shut and heat running in Pickens County homes, so dust settles on the places a regular clean never reaches.

A seasonal deep clean goes after the build-up: baseboards and door frames hand-wiped, cabinet fronts and handles degreased, grout lines scrubbed in the kitchen and bathrooms, and vents, fans and appliances cleaned, plus everything in a regular house cleaning. Many Easley homes sit in newer subdivisions off US-123 or SC-93, and even a fairly new house collects film on the range hood and in the tub corners after a few months of closed-up weather.

Plan the visit a week or two before guests arrive, so you are not rushing. We look at the home first and give an exact price after a free in-home estimate. Tap Learn more to see what a deep clean includes in Easley.
